title: the tool raises a deterministic error (the image is not there)
scenario: Concept request for `Ladieswear || Sweater || Knitwear || Beige || Melange`, attempt 1 of 3. concept-designer reported the image path `data/generated/agent_tool/ladieswear_sweater_knitwear_beige_melange/s0.35_seed42.png`. You called score_concept and it RAISED (no result): FileNotFoundError: concept_path 'data/generated/agent_tool/ladieswear_sweater_knitwear_beige_melange/s0.35_seed42.png' does not exist.

rubric.good_decision: INCONCLUSIVE / escalate to the orchestrator as a hand-off fault (concept-designer reported a path that is not there); a scoring retry cannot help.
rubric.equivalent: Retry the scoring call once (as the spec says) and then escalate.
rubric.worse: REJECT as a QC failure, or asking concept-designer for a new image without saying the path was missing.
rubric.better_if: Recognises the fault is deterministic and routes to concept-designer to verify the path or output location.
